meta_description: Every milestone of the OpenDrone project with a receipt: first commits, fab orders, bench validations, certifications, upstream merges.
title: Dated, like everything else in the repo.
event_esc20_first_commit_detail: The project starts as one [4-in-1 ESC](/products/openesc) design.
event_esc_build_video_detail: How drone ESCs work (so I built my own).
event_esc30_repo_split_title: OpenESC 30×30 split into its own repo
event_esc_first_production_files_detail: 20×20 V1 and 30×30 V0.1 gerbers, BOM and placement.
event_fc_mini_first_commit_detail: A stripped, cost-down flight controller begins.
event_bf_osd_merged_title: RP2350 framebuffer OSD merged into Betaflight
event_bf_osd_merged_detail: The OSD driver the RP2354 FCs depend on lands upstream, contributed by the Betaflight community (betaflight#14882).
event_fc_build_video_detail: How flight controllers work (so I built my own).
event_esc_validation_exports_title: ESC production exports for the validation run
event_esc_validation_exports_detail: Rev2 20×20 and Rev1 30×30 sent out as a combined panel.
event_rx_fab_ordered_detail: All four receiver variants on one fab order.
event_charger_first_commit_detail: LiPo charger spec and part selection start in public.
event_site_redesign_detail: The current look of opendrone.be goes live.
event_frame_first_commit_detail: 3" and 5" CNC carbon frames, CAD from Onshape. Repo not public yet.
event_esc_bench_validation_detail: Test records logged in OpenDrone-Testing; publication pending.
event_rx_rf_baselines_detail: Mono and Gemini link budgets measured and logged.
event_rx_range_video_title: OpenRX video and range test published
event_esc20_rework_proposal_title: External contributor proposes a full 20×20 rework
event_esc20_rework_proposal_detail: Issue #8: exactly the kind of contribution the license invites.
event_frame_samples_ordered_detail: 10× 3" and 10× 5" sample sets on their way.
event_library_live_title: Shared library live across ten repos
event_frame_v01_tagged_title: [OpenFrame](/products/openframe) v0.1 tagged, first CNC pack ordered
event_batch1_planned_detail: The first stocked run of the flight controllers and ESCs goes into costing with board suppliers.
event_hardware_validated_detail: Both [ESCs](/products/openesc), both [FCs](/products/openfc-lite) and all four [OpenRX](/products/openrx) variants pass bench validation.
event_oshwa_certified_detail: BE000026 through BE000033, both FCs, both ESCs, all four receivers.
event_release_tags_cut_title: Release tags cut on the validated boards
event_release_tags_cut_detail: rev2 on OpenESC 20×20 and both FCs, rev1 on OpenESC 30×30.
event_batch1_paid_detail: 250 of each of the four boards: both [FCs](/products/openfc-lite) and both [ESCs](/products/openesc). Ships late October 2026.
